subject: ela
intro: Analyze how an author unfolds ideas.

items.prompt:
The sequence in which an author makes points is their:
A) order
B) font
C) page count

Linking one idea to another is a:
A) connection
B) title
C) rhyme

Authors unfold their ideas in a:
A) deliberate order
B) random pile
C) single word

An author first defines a disease, then traces its spread, then explains the cure. This order:
A) builds understanding step by step
B) is random
C) hides the topic
items.answer: A) builds understanding step by step

solution.answer: A) builds understanding step by step

items.prompt:
An author writes, 'Building on this point, we can now see...' This mainly:
A) draws a connection to an earlier idea
B) starts a new unrelated topic
C) ends the text
items.answer: A) draws a connection to an earlier idea

solution.answer: A) draws a connection to an earlier idea

items.prompt:
Why does the ORDER of points matter in an analysis?
A) it shapes how clearly the reader can follow the ideas
B) it never matters
C) only the length matters
items.answer: A) it shapes how clearly the reader can follow the ideas

steps: Order aids clarity. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) it shapes how clearly the reader can follow the ideas

items.prompt:
An author presents the history of a law, then its current effects, then proposed reforms. This order BEST helps the reader:
A) understand how the past led to the present and why reform is proposed
B) get confused
C) skip the argument
items.answer: A) understand how the past led to the present and why reform is proposed

steps: Sequence builds the argument. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) understand how the past led to the present and why reform is proposed

items.prompt:
To analyze how an author UNFOLDS an analysis, you should examine:
A) the order of points, how each is developed, and the connections between them
B) only the word count
C) only the title
items.answer: A) the order of points, how each is developed, and the connections between them

steps: Order + development + connections. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) the order of points, how each is developed, and the connections between them
